notes: Synthetic: from github.com/openai/openai-openapi openapi.json at 26a299159673d20d5cf0faf10e691beed3fed52d (2026-10-28), POST /audio/transcriptions: CreateTranscriptionResponseJson (text, usage of type "tokens") and the operation's "Default" example verbatim but for the model (the dated gpt-4o-mini-transcribe snapshot). The adapter lifts text and passes the body through. Requests carry the uploaded file's name ("file"); the test uploads placeholder bytes, so a recording needs real audio. Not covered: streaming transcription (transcript.text.delta / .done events), because models.TranscriptionRequest has no stream field (gap O22): a request.json with "stream" would also be read as a chat stream case by the harness.

allowed_unknown_fields.reason: known gap O18: the upstream usage is ignored; the server prices transcription and translation from the uploaded WAV's duration (server/handlers_audio.go), so token-billed gpt-4o-*-transcribe models are priced by the wrong unit and non-WAV uploads go unpriced.
